ICS: “We can see that her body is strong and reflexes are intact, but her mind and body are not communicating in a healthy way. The body has learned a pattern of weakness that is possibly triggered by environmental factors. This pattern needs to be re-wired, which will take some time.”
“I see that this is really affecting her daily life. It must be hard to not be able to participate in [school, sport, activity].”
“This diagnosis can be frustrating for families because there is not a specific test for this condition”
